messages:
Ava: heads-up — compact console on small phones: job list rows are wrapping and action pills collapse into multiple lines. users on iPhone SE reported tap misses. screenshot: https://img.internal/compact-issue.png
Sam: confirmed on dev. .table-cell has `min-width` so when labels wrap the row height jumps. looks rough when names are long UUIDs.
Priya: quick question: do we prefer truncation with tooltip or allow wrap? truncation keeps visual rhythm but hides info.
Jin: leaning truncation (single-line) + per-row overflow menu. keep primary action prominent as a floating FAB on list pages.
Ava: floating primary sounds good, but must not obscure row content when scrolling. maybe show when user stops scrolling or as a bottom-aligned FAB with safe-area padding.
Sam: CSS experiment: `text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden;` + max-width calc for name column helps. also tested `mask-image` for mid-ellipsis but cross-browser is flaky.
Priya: can we do mid-ellipsis for hashes? it preserves prefix/suffix. fallback to normal ellipsis on older browsers.
Jin: implement mid-ellipsis via JS splice for predictable behavior and screenreader-friendly full text in `aria-label`. avoids visual-only solutions.
Ava: sidebar issue: collapsed rail is expanding on accidental edge swipes while scrolling lists. users hit it while scrolling horizontally in some pages.
Sam: current expansion threshold is 10px. bumping to 20px + require a 50ms hold before expanding reduces false positives.
Jin: add a visible 6px handle and an expanded touch target area so it's discoverable but less accidental. also ensure keyboard toggle still works.
Priya: copy/accessibility: replace visually-only `⋯` with a button that has `aria-label="More actions"` and `aria-haspopup="menu"`. tooltip text should read: "Show full name" on long-press.
a11y-bot: accessibility reminder: icon-only controls need `aria-label`. ensure focus outline visible, menu uses role="menu" and items are role="menuitem". maintain 44x44 hit area and test with VoiceOver/TalkBack.
Sam: PR opened -> #3491 includes CSS truncation, per-row overflow menu, floating FAB, and sidebar threshold change. small JS for mid-ellipsis fallback.
Jin: added e2e a11y check and a mobile visual regression. targeting canary tomorrow.
Priya: QA ask: can mobile team smoke test on iPhone SE (Safari) + Pixel 4a (Chrome) and report any clipped touch targets? link to build: https://ci.internal/redwood/1287
Ava: thanks — i'll update the figma spec with the FAB placement and sidebar handle. demo: https://figma.com/proto/compact-console-v2
Sam: left a tiny CSS nit in the PR: prefer `gap: 8px` and avoid using `!important`.
Jin: noted. will address and merge after 2 approvals. watching for regressions. :thumbsup:
